summaries.R1-L1: Over-invoicing can move extra money to the seller disguised as payment for goods. The officer could ask the customer for a justification of this exceptionally high price.
summaries.R1-L2: Over-invoicing can move extra money to the seller disguised as payment for goods. The officer could ask the customer for a justification of this unusually high price.
summaries.R2-L1: An implausible quantity-value relationship can indicate misrepresentation of the goods' true value. The officer could ask the customer to explain how two pieces of this item could be worth such a high amount.
summaries.R2-L2: An implausible quantity-value relationship can indicate misrepresentation of the goods' true value. The officer could ask the customer to provide further documentation supporting the declared value for this quantity.
